tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mchod pa'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mchod pa'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i mdog can he ru ka dpal nam mkha'i sku// nyi ma 'khyil pa nyi ma'i mdangs can rdo rje phag mo nyi mas 'khyud// skar ma'i mdog can skar ma ltar bkra phyag rgya drug gi skar ma'i rgyan// rnam par bkram pas rnam par bkra ba'i zhabs kyi pad+mo'i rnam par 'dud// he ru ka dpal sgrub pa'i thabs// spyod pa'i rdo rje'i gzhung bzhin du// bdag gis bkod mod slar yang ni// de mnyes byed pa'i cho ga bshad// dkyil 'khor bsgrub dang mchod pa dang*// bka' drin nos dang dngos grub blang*// bdag nyid mchod dang mjug gi las// rnam pa drug gis yang dag bsdu// de la sngags pas tho rangs la sogs pa'i dus su/ ji skad bshad pa'i rim pa gnyis bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdus te he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal khru gang las mi chung ba/ ba las byung ba lngas khye ma med par byugs pa'i mdun du/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ nang gi mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma gsum bsham/ rdo rje dril bu mdun du bzhag la/ mchod rdzas rnams suṃ bhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa'am snod rnams kyi nang du/ yi ge gsum las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas rnams ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bas sa dang nam mkha' dang bar snang gang bar bskyed la/ so so'i sngags dang yi ge gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bdud rtsi'i ri lu dang sbyar ba'i dri'i chus/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang dbang ldan nas brtsams te/

g.yon skor du byug cing sum bha'i sngags brjod la/ der srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom mo// de nas bsrung ba'i phyir lag pa ma bteg par me tog gcig dbus su bzhag nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ sgrub pa'i thabs las 'byung ba bzhin gzhal yas khang pa bsgoms la/ lha'i gnas sum cu so bdun dang*/ nang gi grwa bzhi'i thod pa dang*/ phyi'i dur khrod brgyad kyi gnas su dri'i thig le me tog cung zad re dang bcas pa bkod pa rnams/ gdan dang gzhir dmigs nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gis maṇ+ḍal la reg te/ pu dzā o a go rā de mā/ kā o tri ko ka la kā hi/ pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/ zhes brjod pas rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir blta'o// de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po gnyis dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi so so'i sngags dang*/ thod pa dang dur khrod rnams la yi ge gsum brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu rnams rim pa bzhin bkod la/ me tog gi tshom bur grub pa tsam gyis lha'i sku dang*/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ dur khrod rnams su gyur par skad cig gis lhag par mos pa'am/ yang na tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du ā li gnyis las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha dang bcas pa'i kā li gnyis las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bar du hūm̐ dang am̐ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa rnams gcig tu 'dres pa rnams las byung ba'i he ru ka yab yum gyi sku yongs su rdzogs par bskyed la/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nye bar bkug nas zhal du zhugs te snying gar bzhu nas/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le bzhi bcur gyur pa las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha sum cu so drug dang*/ bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i thod pa rnams su gyur pa/ sbyor mtshams nas spros nas so so'i gdan la 'khod par bsam/

'di'i lugs la dur khrod rnams gzhal yas khang pa bskyed pa'i dus su bsgom par bya'o// lū hi pa'i ltar na/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgra tshul las bskyed do// de nas go cha gnyis shes nas/ ye shes 'khor lo rnam par bsgom// sngags dang phyag rgya sbyor shes nas// dam tshig 'khor lo la myur gzhug /de nas dbang bskur te/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab bo// gtso bo'i rigs bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med par bsam/ dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi cha la bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang*/ 'khor yug kun tu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis gang bar blta'o// dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i rim pa'o// sngags dang phyi dang yid las byung*// nang dang mnyes dang bla med dang*// bstod dang de bzhin gtor ma ste// dkyil 'khor mchod pa rnam pa brgyad// de la thog mar sngags kyis mchod pa'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pas/ lha rnams kyi 'od dang gzi brjid tshad med par 'phel zhing rgyud bskul bas/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bdag la thim nas bdag byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing sngags rnams bzlas par bya'o// sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag yin no// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ wī re shā ya/ ma hā kalpā g+ni saṃ ni bhā ya/ dza ṭā ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya/ daṃ ṣ+ṭā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya/ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/ byā gh+rā dzi nām+ba ra dha rā ya/ ma hā dhūm brān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ hraḥhraḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi ra an+ta mā lā ba lam+bi ne/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhū dzaṃ ga sarbam+bā/

tardza ya tardza ya/ ā kaḍ+ḍha/ ā kaḍ+ḍha/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ/ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ/ hāṃ hāṃ/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa/ yab kyi rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba ra swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ hri ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra bā ra hī bam̐/ ār+yā pa rā dzi te tre lo kya mā te ma hā bid+yā shwa rī/ sarba bhū ta bha ya ba he ma hā badz+re/ badz+rā sa ne/ a dzi te/ a pa rā dzi te/ ba sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi/ sho ṣa ṇi/ ro ṣa ṇi/ kro dhe/ ka rā le ni/ trā sa ni mā ra ṇi/ pra bhe da ni/ pa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+waṃ bha ni mo ha ni/ badz+ra bā ra hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha ge tad+ya thā/ pro taṃ ge pro taṃ ge ha na ha na prā ṇā na/ kiṃ ki ni khiṃ khi ni/ dhu na dhu na/ badz+ra haste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dhā ri ṇi/ ma hā pi si ta māṃ sa a sha ni/ mā nu ṣa an+t+ra prā pṛt+ti/ sān+ni dh+ya na ra si ra/ mā lā gran+thi ta/ dhā ri ṇi/ sum+bha ni sum+bhe/ ha na ha na pra ṇāṃ sarba pa shu bā nāṃ/ ma hā mān+sa/ ts+tshe da ni kro dha mūr+t+te/ daṃ ṣ+ṭā ka rā li ni ma hā mu dre shrī he ru ka de ba s+ya/ a gra ma hi ṣi sa ha sra shi re sa ha sra bā ha be/ sha ta sa ha sra a na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa lā mu khi/ piṅga la lo tsa ni/ badz+ra sha ri re/ badz+ra ā sa ne/ mi li te/ mi li te/ he he/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ dhu ru dha ru/ mu ru mu ru/ muñtsa muñtsa/ a dwe te ma hā yo gi nī/ pa ṭhi ta sid+dhe/ dreṃ dhaṃ dreṃ dhaṃ/ graṃ graṃ/ he he ha ha/ bhī me ha sa ha sa/ bī re hā hā ho ho/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ trai lo kya bi nā sha ni/ sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri bā re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ siṃ ha rū pe khaḥ

ga dza rū pe gaḥ trai lo kya u da re sa mu dra me kha le/ gra sa gra sa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bī ra/ a dwai te hūm̐ hūm̐ hāḥhāḥm hā pa shu mo ha ni/ ma hā yo gī shwa rī twaṃ ḍā ki nī/ sarba lo kā nāṃ ban+da ni sat+yaḥ pra t+ya ya kā ri ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhū ta trā sa ni ma hā bī re pa ra ma/ sid+dhe yo gī shwa rī phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o// oṃ tsau rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye ba'i snying po'i snying po'o// oṃ ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags so// oṃ ka ra ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa a k+ṣī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bhā wa tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ trā sa ya trā sa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā se hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bī ra ma tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrauṃ hrauṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khar+pa rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hraḥhraḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa rī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dru mats+tshā ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e rā ba tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhai ra pi ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi ra an+t+ra mā lā a ba lam+bi ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su rā bhak+ṣī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ ga sarbam+bā/ tardza ya tardza ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sh+yā ma de bī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā kaḍ+ḍha ā kaḍ+ḍha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya kar+ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dzaṇauṃ dzaṇauṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kha gā na ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣ+māṃ k+ṣ+māṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ haṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hiṃ hiṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shoṇ+ḍi ni ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bīr+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sngags so// oṃ kā kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ u lū kā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sū kar+ya s+ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā dhī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dhū tī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃ ṣ+ṭī ṇī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags so// lū hi pa'i lugs ltar na zhal bzhi pa'i sngags dang*/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i ming spel ba dang*/ yab kyi rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ming spel ba'i sngags brjod par bya'o// sngags kyi mchod pa'o// de nas phyi'i mchod pa ni/ gong du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas dngos su dbul zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes kun la sbyar la/

ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad du dbul/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās zhabs bsil phul bas/ zhabs bkrus par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog dbu la dbul/ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos shangs la/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me spyan la/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab sku la/ badz+ra nai bi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas zhal du/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ nā da saṃ bha be ta/ badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho āḥkhaṃ swā hās rol mo snyan la dbul lo// de nas yid las byung ba'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ oṃ bī ni badz+rī nī hūm̐ āḥzhes pas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las pi wang ma sngon mo phyung nas/ dpag tu med par gyur pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchod par bsam zhing*/ pad+ma yongs su bskor ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes brjod pas mchod pa'i yul gsal btab nas/ pi wang dkrol ba'i tshul du bya zhing*/ bī ni badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul/ tshul de dag 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar bar bya'o// oṃ baṃ se badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs gling bu ma ser mo phyung nas baṃ se badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ mṛ taṃ ga badz+rī nī hūm̐ āḥs rnga zlum ma dmar mo phyung nas mṛ taṃ ga badz+rī nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ murdzi badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs rdza rnga ma ljang gu phyung nas murdzi badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ ha s+ye badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs bzhad ma dmar mo rdo rje khu tshur kha'i 'gram du 'jog pa phyung nas ha s+ye badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/

oṃ lā s+ye badz+rī nī hūm̐ āḥs sgeg mo sngon mo rdo rje dang dril bu dkur 'dzin pa phyung nas/ lā s+ye badz+rī nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ gīrti badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs glu ma dmar mo ting ting shag 'dzin pa phyung nas/ gīrti badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ nirti badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs gar ma ljang gu phyung nas/ nirti badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs me tog ma dkar mo phyung nas/ puṣ+paṃ badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ dhū paṃ badz+rī nī hūm̐ āḥs bdug spos ma sngon mo phyung nas/ dhū paṃ badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ dī paṃ badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs mar me ma dmar mo phyung nas/ dī paṃ badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ gan+dhaṃ badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs dri chab ma ljang gu phyung la/ gan+dhaṃ badz+rī nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ ā dar+sha rū pa badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo me long 'dzin pa phyung la/ ā dar+sha rū pa badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ ra sa badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs ro rdo rje ma dmar mo phyung la/ ra sa badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ spar+ṣe badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs reg rdo rje ma ljang gu gos 'dzin pa phyung la/ spar+ṣe badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ri nī hūm̐ āḥs chos kyi dbyings kyi rdo rje ma dkar mo chos 'byung 'dzin pa phyung la/ rdo rje bsdams pa las/ mthe bong dang mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung rnams brkyang nas gru gsum du byas pa'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ dharma dhā tu badz+ri nī badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ gis dbul bar bya'o// lū hi pa'i rjes su 'brang ba ltar na lha mo rnams phyag bzhi ma/

dang po gnyis kyis rang gi ming gi don gyi mtshan ma rnams 'dzin la/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu'am/ ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o// nag po spyod pa'i rjes su 'brang ba ltar na phyag gnyis ma rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin pa yin no// phyag rgya rnams ni phyag mtshan gyi tshul du byed pa nyid do// de nas snying ga nas rin po che sna bdun rim pa bzhin phyung nas dbul bar bya ste/ tshigs su bcad pa brjod pa'i tshe/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa brjod pa'i tshe pad kor gyi phyag rgya bya'o// de'ang*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /ces brjod nas lag pa gnyis rgyab sbyar sor mo rnams so sor bsnol nas lto sbyar la mthe bong gnyis bkug pa 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa'i mthar/ tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// de nas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ces brjod nas khu tshur gnyis sbyar la gung mo brkyang nas mdzub mo'i tshigs bcag pa dang mthe bong sbyar ba rin po che'i phyag rgya bcings la/ ma ṇi rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings ma rab rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /ces brjod nas rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo sbyar ba brkyang pa'i tshigs dang por mdzub mo gnyis sbyar ba btsun mo'i phyag rgya bcings la/ wa ti rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog

/ces brjod nas rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo sbyar ba brkyang nas mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor bsgreng ba blon po'i phyag rgya bcings la/ ma ha ta rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ces brjod nas lag pa g.yas pa glang po'i sna ltar brkyang pa'i gru mor g.yon pa'i thal mos brten pa glang po'i phyag rgya byas la/ hasti rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las yongs grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /ces brjod nas/ khu tshur gnyis mthe bo so sor dbye zhing gung mo sbyar ba dang*/ srin lag sbyar ba so sor brkyang ba/ rta mchog gi phyag rgya bcings la/ tu raṅga a shwa rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// 'jigs bral tshogs ni thob par shog /ces brjod nas g.yon pa phub 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yas pa ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul du bya ba dmag dpon gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ khaḍ+ga rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// //de nas dngos su 'byor ba dang*/ snying ga nas rim pa bzhin spros pa'i 'dod yon lngas mchod par bya ste/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// zhes brjod nas thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba gzugs kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta la sogs pa'i mthar/ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan sgra snyan yid 'ong ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// zhes brjod nas rol mo dkrol zhing*/

shap+ta kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// zhes brjod nas thal mo stong par sbyar ba las mtheb mdzub sbyar ba dri'i dung chos kyi phyag rgya byas la/ gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// zhes brjod nas zhal zas 'bul ba'i tshul ro'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshim byed pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// zhes brjod nas lag pa gnyis 'khyud pa reg bya'i phyag rgya byas la/ spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ zhes pas dbul lo// yid las byung ba'i mchod pa'o// //de nas nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ dngos su bshams pa gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gtor bas gtor ba'i rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i thod pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar gyur pas mchod par bsam zhing*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod cing dbul lo// de nas gong du brjod pa'i sngags rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la dbul zhing*/ yi dam gzhan dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la so so'i sngags dang yi ge gsum brjod pas phul nas rang gi lce la myang zhing gnas gsum du thig le bkod pas rang gi lus kyi lha la'ang mchod nas/

chos skyong dang dur khrod na gnas pa dang*/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor rnams dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad la'ang byin pas tshim par bya'o// de ltar bdud rtsis mchod pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad rab tu dgyes nas yi ge bdun pa'i sgra sgrogs par bsam zhing rang gis kyang sngags dngos su brjod bzhin pas rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya'o// nang gi mchod pa'o// de nas dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde bas phyi nang gi lha'i tshogs thams cad mchod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha yab yum rnams kyang snyoms par zhugs nas bde ba chen pos lhag par mnyes par bsams la/ phyag rgya chen po'i phyag rgya bca' zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3ham̐/ zhes brjod do// rab tu mnyes pa'i mchod pa'o// de nas thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba las sor mo rnams kyi tshigs dbus ma bcag pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya byas la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin gyis rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gi mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam gyi dbang gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod de se gol brdab/ yang snying gar phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ sarba bid/ pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ā brta ho/ na maḥsaman+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/

a bhisma ra ye/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu ā kā sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga tā pa ri sho dha le maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pra ṇi dhi/ puṇ+ya dz+nyā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba le na/ bhan+dha swas+thā na/ ba le na tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas se gol brdabs la mchod par bya'o// bla na med pa'i mchod pa'o// de nas sngar spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu bstod par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ na mo bhā ga wa te wī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpā g+ni saṃ ni bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃ ṣ+ṇā kā rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra shu pā sho d+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+rā dzi nām+ba ra dha rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhūm brān+dha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi rkang pa brgyad pa dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra bā ra hī baṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo ār+ya a pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bi d+ye shwa rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha ya ba he ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne/ a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+ra ma ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dhe ka rā li ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥtrā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni ba rā dza ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni s+t+wam+bha ni mo ha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā ra hī ma hā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa brjod pas bstod do// gzhan yang rgyas par bstod par spro na/ rgyal ba sprul pa dus mtha'i me ltar rab tu 'jigs mdzad cing*// ram̐ ram̐ rnam 'khor ut+pal sngo 'dra nyi ma brgya yi gzi// rdo rje dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ gar bcas oṃ oṃ dag par ldan// tshangs dang lha chen khyab 'jug mgo bcad dbu yi cod pan can// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ha ha zhes bya khro ba dang bcas pas// mi yi seng ge dregs pa 'joms mdzad zhabs kyis gnon mdzad cing*// a la la yi sgra sgrogs bgegs rnams yongs su 'dar bar mdzad// cang te'u sgra sgrogs lha chen khyab 'jug dag gi pags pa bsnams// thugs rje che sprul rab khros dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥhūm̐ mdzad cing*// lak+ṣ+mī gau rī zhabs kyis gnon cing ku tsar rab tu bzhugs// lha rnams mgo la zhabs kyis mnan bzhugs bde gshegs dbu rgyan can// lha rnams kun gyi 'khor gyi 'khor los yongs bskor mdzad pa po// hu lu hu ya dziṃ dziṃ traṃ baṃ rgyu ma thod rlon gyi// phreng ba 'dzin cing rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'jigs shing khro ba yi// glu sgra mi bzad hu lu hu lus rab tu rmongs mdzad cing*// rdo rje chen mo mā ma kīs ni sku lus rnam par brgyan// dur khrod rab tu 'jigs shing gar gyis 'khor los tshogs skrag mdzad// ka ha ka ha'i bzhad sgra drag pos gnod sbyin skrag rengs mdzad// brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs shing bi bi sha nas sku la brgyan// bskal pa grangs med rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dus kyi mthar yang ni// ha na ha na da ha da ha phaṭa kyi mdzad pa can// stong pa'i ngang las sku gsung thugs kyi sangs rgyas rnam par 'phro// phyin ci log zhen lta ngan ma lus mtha' dag med mdzad cing*// gu lu gu lu dzam̐ dzam̐ yam̐ yam̐ gis ni zhi bar mdzad// nam mkha' dag dang mnyam pa'i ting 'dzin thugs ni rnam par smin// bde ba chen po khyod ni mam̐ mam̐ zhes ni mdzad pa can// sems can don du thugs rje chen po'i mdzad pa mdzad pa po// ā li kā li rab tu sbyor ba'i sdom pa gsang ba can// bcom ldan mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig ma lus ston par mdzad pa yi// dpal chen he ru ka ni brtan g.yo'i bdag po de la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig he ru ka yi bstod pa 'di bsgoms phyag 'tshal ba'i// lha dang mi rnams gsang ba gsum bdag he ru ka yi gzugs 'dzin 'gyur// zhes pas bstod do// gzhan yang spro na ci ltar shes pas bstod par bya ste bstod pa'o//

//de nas gtor mas mchod pa ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa gnyis las/ snga ma ni sgrub pa'i thabs su bstan pa ltar bya zhing*/ gnyis pa ni gtor ma la lag pa g.yon dang g.yas dang gnyis ka dang*/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya rim pa bzhin bstan zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas stong pa dang*/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i thod pa dang*/ bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ kha dog dang ro bcud phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam mo// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyes su bskor zhing mig gyen du bltas la/ ngag tu oṃ badz+ra a ral+li ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥzhes pa dang phaiṃ gyi sgra drag tu brjod nas/ sems kyis gnod sbyin dang srin po dang 'byung po la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad mdun du bkug par dmigs la/ de rnams kyi zhal nas byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas nas/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi/ un+mā da/ a pasmā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+dā da yaḥ i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhim+p+ra yats+tshan+tu/ ya thai waṃ/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ dziṃ gha tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya/ sat+su khaṃ bi shud+dha sa hā yi ka bha ban+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas phul nas/ slar yang phyi dang nang gis mchod la/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// ma lus pa ni thams cad dag

/'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir// thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams// dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa// gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms// rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing*// mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i// gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yogs bcas pas// dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams rgyas shing chos 'phel dang*// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces phrin las bcol nas/ rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas byin dbab cing bkra shis par bya'o// gtor ma ste mchod pa'i rim pa'o// //rgyun bshags sdom pa gzung ba dang*// dam tshig rjes su dran pa dang*// gnang ba rjes su nod pa ste// bka' drin nod pa rnam pa bzhi// da ltar mchod pas mnyes pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du/ sdig pa dang dam tshig gi nyes pa sbyang ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gzung ba'i phyir yang yang phyag 'tshal nas tsog pur 'dug la/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ brjod par 'gyur ba'i don dran bzhin pas slob dpon bhu ri pas mdzad pa'i rgyun bshags ltar rgyas par bya ba'am/

yang na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas sdom pa mtha' dag gzung ba'i phyir/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi dang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum brjod pas blang ngo*//

//de nas bsrung ba'i dam tshig rjes su bskyang pa'i bsam pas/ nang par sngar langs sems dag nyid// ma lus las ni byas nas kyang*// bsrung dang bza' la sogs pa yi// sdom pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo*// lus srog ltos pa med par yang*// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung*// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re zhing ni bzla bar bya// gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba re re bsrung ba ni// gnyis med pang na 'khor lor gnas// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// sha dang chang sogs gang ci'ang rung*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// thams cad gnyis med pang na gnas// he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs// 'khor ba dag kyang mi spang zhing*// mya ngan 'das la dgar mi bya// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la// khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing*// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma bgom par mi bya'o// dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis// tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur// bud med thams cad mthong ba na// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing*// spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*// lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab// khyod ma bdag ni bu yin te// ji srid byang chub byung bar du// byang chub yan lag nu ma las// byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs// gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i// bslab pa blangs pa sngon 'gro bas// sgra stong la sogs sngon 'gro ba'i// tshangs par spyod pa shin tu srungs// dam tshig de la rtag gnas te// de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid// spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras 'dod pa'i// yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub 'gyur// zhes bya ba dang*/ lha mo gzhan dang kun sbyor ba// 'dod la chags par gyur 'gro ba// mi g.yo bdag gzhan gnyis pa med// gnyis su med dang thogs pa med// dam tshig spyad pa spyod pa dang*// bud med dbang phyug shin tu sbyor// tshangs spyod de bzhin bsam gtan gnas// khro med rgyun ni kun du spyod// 'di brgyad dam tshig kun spyod yin// zhes brjod nas dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus par rjes su dran par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos/

rigs kyi bu khyod tshul 'dis gnas par gyis shig dang*/ myur du mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro zhes gnang ba byin zhing*/ bdag nyid kyis kyang de ltar khas blangs par bsam mo// bka' drin nod pa'o// bzlas dang 'dod yon gsol gdab pa// dngos grub bslang ba rnam pa gnyis// de ltar dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa dang ldan pas/ sngags kyi bzlas pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud bskul nas dngos grub bslang ba'i phyir/ sngags kyi mchod pa'i skabs su brjod pa'i tshul gyis/ gang spro ba'i sngags la ji srid mi skyo ba'i bar du bzlas par bya'o// de nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir/ khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi// bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba'i// bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis// rab tu rmongs pas bsten par byed// bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol// rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde// a la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod// a i ā a ra ho/ rab dgyes mgon po dgyes zhugs mdzod// mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i bde ba stsol// dgyes pa'i bde ba stsol bar mdzod// zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa// bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol// thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod// a la la ho/ bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur// bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol// bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas// chags pa'i dngos pos khyod ma bsgyur// bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod// pad+ma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis// bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod// 'di yis mgon po bskul na ni// dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub// snyan cing 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ni// dpyid kyi rgyal mos glu blangs pas// dri med mkha' 'gro drwa ba yis// gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar gsol ba gdab cing*/ gzhan yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes bya ba la sogs pa ji ltar 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab par bya'o// dngos grub bslang ba'o//

//rgyun dang de bzhin khyad par te// bdag nyid mchod pa rnam pa gnyis// de la rgyun ni/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas su mchod pa'i mthar sngags dang phyi la sogs pa dang zas kyi mchod pa sgrub thabs ltar bya zhing*/ lag pa'i mchod pa ni/ zhu ba dang gong bu la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i rdzas rnams mdun du bzhag nas/ lag pa g.yon pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing mnyes nas sen mo lnga bsdus te dbus dang sen mo lnga la me tog gam thig le bkod pa zla ba'i gdan drug tu dmigs pa'i steng du mthe bor oṃ ha las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ mdzub mor na maḥhi las rnam par snang mdzad ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ gung mo la swā hā hu las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ srin lag la bau ṣa ṭa he las dpal he ru ka nag po rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ mthe'u chung du hūm̐ hūm̐ ho las rdo rje nyi ma dmar ser rin po che 'dzin pa/ bsdus pa la phaṭa ham̐ las rta mchog ljang gu ral gri 'dzin pa ste/ g.yon pa rnams ni g.yas pa'i phyag mtshan gyis yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing g.yon brkyang pas bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas lag pa'i mthil du rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa dmigs la/ lte ba dang 'dab ma lngar me tog gam thig le bkod pa zla ba'i gdan du bsgoms pa'i steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ las rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor gyis rim pa bzhin/ ham̐ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo/ hriṃ mam̐ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma ser mo/ hūm̐ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma ljang gu/ phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi ka du ba'i mdog can te/ thams cad kyang gri gug dang*/ thod pa 'dzin pa/ skra grol ba phyogs kyi gos can phyag rgya lngas brgyan cing g.yon brkyang bas gnas par bsam mo// de rnams rim pa bzhin yab yum yin pa'i phyir/

yab kyi gnas su yum dang*/ yum gyi gnas su yab snyoms par zhugs par bsam mo// yang na yi ge nyid lha'i ngo bor bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med do// lū hi pa'i dgongs pa ltar rgyas pa la spro na rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa ste/ g.yas sngo zhing g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis na thod pa dang cang te'u dang*/ g.yon gyi 'og ma gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa'o// gzhan rnams ni phyag bzhi pa ste/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa'o// rdo rje phag mo'ang zhal gsum phyag drug ma ste/ zhal g.yas sngo zhing g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas kyi 'og ma gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa/ g.yon gyi 'og ma gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo 'dzin pa'o// gzhan rnams ni zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma ste/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa yin la/ thams cad kyi dang po gnyis ni gong du brjod pa'i phyag mtshan 'dzin pa nyid yin no// gzhan yang lag pa'i sa'i khams ni ltung byed ma/ chu'i khams ni gsod byed ma/ me'i khams ni 'gugs byed ma/ rlung gi khams ni gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ nam mkha'i khams ni pad+ma'i drwa ba can ma ste snying po'i rnal 'byor ma lngar bsgom mo// de nas phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan lag pa'i rgyab tu shar bar blta ba'am/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na lha'i gnas rnams su thig le bkod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha yongs su rdzogs par bltas nas thams cad kyang pho nya gsum dbyer mi phyed par mos la so so'i sngags brjod cing*/ me tog la sogs pa'i phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ zhu ba dang gong bu'i rdzas rnams kyis mchod nas mnyes par bya'o// de nas rdzas rnams kyi phyed mi spyad par dben pa'i gnas su bzhag cing*/ phyed ni longs spyad pa'i kha zas rnams dang bsre bar bya'o// de nas lag pa g.yon pa la bdud rtsi gtor zhing lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnyes pas lha rnams snyoms par zhugs par bsams nas/

g.yon pa'i srin lag gis dpral ba mgrin pa snying gar reg cing lus thams cad la byugs pas lha rnams kyang lus la thim par bsam zhing oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas g.yon gyi kun tu spyod pas/ nang gi sbyin sreg gis lus kyi lha rnams tshim par bya'o// de nas lhag ma bsdus pa la dngos sam yid kyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'i nang nas chang gi kha phru btab la/ yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ a kā ro'i mthar/ oṃ sarba kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa sī swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po thams cad la sbyin par bya'o// de nas rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas shis par bya'o// khyad par gyi mchod pa tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus su tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgyas par byed na/ thog mar las kyi slob mas tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs pa dang bcas pa rnams la maṇ+ḍal dang me tog phul nas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab bo// de nas yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ sgrub pa'i thabs bzhin rnal 'byor yongs su rdzogs pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ bdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal la brten na gong du bstan pa ltar bya zhing*/ mi brten na bris sku la sogs pa dmigs pa'i rten yod pa'am med kyang rung ste/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis dmigs la pho nya gsum bsres nas ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas la dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab bo// de nas bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka la thun mong du mchod par bsam zhing*/ bstod pa'i bar ji skad bstan pa bzhin bya'o// bsdus pa la spro na phyi dang nang dang mnyes pa dang bla na med pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod par bya'o// de nas dam tshig can la gtor ma byin nas/

rgyun bshags dang sdom pa gzung ba byas na shin tu legs la ma byas kyang nyes pa med do// de nas tshogs kyi yo byad mngon du byas pa gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i phud dkyil 'khor dang gtor ma la phul nas/ las kyi slob mas phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas rnam lnga 'dod pa bskor ba'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang por ltos// 'du ba rnams la the tshom med// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa yang*// rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du bzhes// zhes brjod cing*/ dam tshig gi rdzas gnyis su med par rim pa bzhin drang ngo*// len pa pos kyang phyag rgya bcas shing*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod chags la sogs dri ma spangs// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes brjod cing blang ngo*// gnyis kar gyi a ho su kha zhes brjod par bya'o// de nas nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ltar phud kyis mchod nas/ lag pa'i mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyad par bya'o// brtsod dang ku cho mi bya zhing*// chags dang sdang ba rnam par spang*// tha mal rtog pas ma g.yengs par// yang nas yang du rnal 'byor bsgom// zas la mi smod tshim par spyad// shin tu bzi bar mi bya zhing*// 'dod yon rdo rje'i bde ba rnams// stong pa nyid kyi rgyas gdab bya// tshogs khang snod bcas gzhal med khang*// 'gro kun lha yi dkyil 'khor te// 'dod yon thams cad mchod pa'i rdzas// kun tu kun nas mchod par bsam// 'di ltar rnam shes rnal 'byor pa// sgo gsum po yis spyad pa'i las// don du mi 'gyur ci zhig yod// thams cad ye shes chen po'i rgyu// kun bzang he ru ka dpal gyi// kun du bzang po'i rnam 'phrul gyis// rnam par rol pa kun bzang nyid// sgrub pa'i tshul la su zhig smod// 'di 'dra gsang gsum mnga' bdag gi /gsung gi gsang ba ches gsang ba// de 'dra dman pa'i yul min phyir// shin tu khyad par 'phags pa yin// gang 'dras 'di 'dra rtogs gyur pa// de 'dra rgyal ba'i slob ma ste// de lta de ltar sgrub byed pa// de de sras kyi thu bo yin// tshogs kyi man ngag rgyud kun gyi// snying po'i tshig ni mdor bsdus pa// 'di 'dra tshogs su
